subject: Geopolitics
title: NATO's Origin and Purpose
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: NATO's Origin and Purpose.

hook.text: NATO was created to keep the Americans in, the Russians out, and the Germans down. All three goals worked.

buildup.text: Founded in 1949, NATO bound North America and Western Europe in a mutual defense pact against Soviet expansion.

discovery.text: The alliance deterred a Soviet attack on Europe for 40 years. Nuclear weapons made the stakes too high to test.

twist.text: When the Cold War ended, NATO lost its original enemy. Critics asked: what is NATO for now?

climax.text: Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine answered the question. NATO found its purpose again almost overnight.

punchline.text: The alliance built for one enemy found another.

quiz.question: What event renewed NATO's sense of purpose after years of debate?
options: China's military buildup in the South China Sea
